plan.summary: BRO-5222: correct 24 Time Out rows credited to the wrong critic. A sweep of all 1,720 stored Time Out rows fetched each page and read its byline ("<Kind> review by <Critic>") or capsule signature ("—<Critic>"); these rows name a different critic than the page. Rows already excluded (duplicate, wrong production, non-review) are left alone. Where the real critic already has a row with the same review, this one is marked a duplicate; otherwise the critic name is corrected.
steps: Fetch every stored Time Out url and classify it with classifyTimeoutPage (scripts/lib/timeout-capsule.js)
For each wrong_critic row not already excluded: criticName edit to the page's critic, or duplicateOf the real critic's existing row when both rows hold the same url
